title: SB1812 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39; Title 49 and Title 50, relative to firearms.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1313): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1313, is amended by deleting the section in its entirety.
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1314(b)(1)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1314(b)(1), is amended by deleting the language ", except as otherwise provided in § 39-17-1313".
SECTION 4 (TCA 39-17-1366(h)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1366(h), is amended by deleting the subsection in its entirety.
SECTION 5 (TCA 49-7-163): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 49-7-163, is amended by deleting the section in its entirety.
SECTION 6 (TCA 50-1-312): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 50-1-312, is amended by deleting the section in its entirety.
